title: First-principles insights into sulfur and nitrogen co-doped Ti2CO2 MXene as an advanced anchoring material for sodium polysulfides in sodium–sulfur batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35586-35597
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05003K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Van Nghia, Trinh Thu Bien, Nguyen Truong Long, Minh Triet Dang
Nitrogen- and sulfur-co-doped Ti2CO2 MXene enhances adsorption and conductivity, effectively suppressing the polysulfide shuttle effect, making it a promising anchoring material for next-generation room-temperature sodium–sulfur batteries.
